findings.desc: doc-promise-undelivered: flow-fact-policy.ts line 36 and process-fact-levels.ts line 324 both still read "bound to the latest signed reviewer run for that lane" but B-6c4d relaxes passes on non-latest material-fresh runs — the rationale now misrepresents the enforced policy and will mislead future callers of the policy registry

doc-promise-undelivered: prompt-registry.ts line 98 still says "Review run validation also checks signature, current-latest run, matching reviewRound, and fresh head/material hashes" — after B-6c4d the validate path accepts non-latest passes, so "current-latest run" is no longer accurate for pass evidence

CHK-001:adversarial:2 intent claims \"net result lane blocked\" but assertReviewRunBindingRaceAcceptsNonLatestFreshPass never calls getGuardFailureReason to assert that the gate actually blocks when a non-latest-run open finding coexists with a non-latest-run pass. The smoke asserts the pass has no stale_run (L1452-1457) and the open finding has stale_run (L1466-1471) separately, but the final \"net result lane blocked\" claim in the evidence note is not validated by a guard-layer assertion. The link from stale_run-in-invalid to gate-blocks is real but left implicit. The analogous cases in assertSupersededReviewPassDoesNotBlockLatestReviewerRun use getGuardFailureReason (L1313) to close this loop; the binding-race function does not.

doc-promise-undelivered: 10 agent template files in packages/main/templates/agents/ (lattice-evaluator.md, lattice-implementer.md, lattice-review-behavior.md, lattice-review-channel.md, lattice-review-concept.md, lattice-review-delivery.md, lattice-review-docs.md, lattice-review-quality.md, lattice-review-scope-plan.md, lattice-review-story-init.md) still carry the old stale lattice:start block text: "Review run validation also checks signature, current-latest run, matching reviewRound, and fresh head/material hashes" — inaccurate after the kind-aware relax; prompt-registry.ts LOAD_BEARING_LATTICE_PROMPT_SLICE was updated but the template .md files were not synced, causing prompt-registry-smoke line 89 to fail (extractLatticeBlock(source) != LOAD_BEARING_LATTICE_PROMPT_SLICE). Deployed mirrors in .claude/agents/ and .lattice-codex/agents/ have the same stale text.

doc-promise-undelivered: docs/requirements/decisions/story-lifecycle.md line 202 still says "the gate accepts only the latest reviewer run with a matching lane, matching reviewRound, valid signature, and still fresh" — after B-6c4d kind-aware relax, PASS evidence no longer requires latest-run; the statement is now inaccurate for passes (it describes the pre-relax policy as a blanket rule). The story scope allowed reconciling decision docs (review-run-binding-race.md was written; session-ownership-and-write-leases.md was reconciled) but story-lifecycle.md was not updated.

doc-code-drift: packages/main/src/core/prompt-registry.ts line 98 still reads 'current-latest run, matching reviewRound, and fresh head/material hashes' — the pre-kind-aware wording that the round-3 commit explicitly reverted. The code (review-run.ts:807 validateEvidenceRunBinding and assertCurrentReviewRunForEvidence:669-676) implements kind-aware binding: the id-recency check is dropped for evidence.kind=pass so PASS evidence on a non-latest-but-material-fresh run is accepted, while FINDING evidence still requires the latest run. The prompt-registry.ts text omits this kind-awareness and implies id-recency is required for all evidence. This contradicts story-lifecycle.md:202, flow-fact-policy.ts review-run-boundary rationale, process-fact-levels.ts review-run-boundary rationale, and review-run-binding-race.md — all of which correctly describe the kind-aware policy. Because prompt-registry.ts is the LOAD_BEARING_LATTICE_PROMPT_SLICE injected into every agent prompt, agents reading it will incorrectly believe id-recency is required for passes, misdiagnosing the relaxed binding.

doc-code-drift: CLAUDE.md line 831 still says collectReviewerEvidenceState checks "current-latest run" uniformly for all evidence kinds. After the kind-aware fix in review-run.ts:807-819, the id-recency (latest-run) check is DROPPED for passes (kind=pass) and KEPT only for open findings (kind=finding). The CLAUDE.md REVIEW->TEST gate-behavior section must be updated to reflect the kind-aware policy.
